searchText: I set up a new fork monitor: https://forkmon.ethdevops.io/. If people here are running nodes that I can add to it, let me know. I'd like to make it pretty large, to cover more ground. If needed, I can set up a persistent ssh tunnel so it can ssh to your server and get RPC access. It even has support for rate limiting, so it can have a very light footprint. Would be neat with OE <@!329594653097721856> or Turbogeth ( <@456226577798135808> ) does anyone have a trace of this transaction: 0x34a039907d397b94f9717fec85bc05fcfb1086c02fb5962205f1c532499b8f0c Geth trace? Give me few minutes, I will try to get it for you it was produced by turbo-geth, not geth, but should be the same thanks <@456226577798135808> , checking! > Would be neat with OE <@!329594653097721856> or Turbogeth ( <@456226577798135808> ) <@!211091239112671234> What sort of interface it is using?
